cases.scenario: The user explicitly requests a Meta-O Orca deep review with one full SHA, intent, scope and two approved vendor-diverse selections. Four otherwise identical proven failures carry emergency-wide, high-impact reachable, bounded operational and local robustness prerequisites.
must: under §A-SESSION-01 prove same-project isolated placement before creating exactly two independent vendor-diverse reviewers
under §A-REVIEW-04 emit the full canonical Review-Execution response with required evidence sections and classify the four proven failures as textual P0, P1, P2 and P3
under §A-RESPONSE-03 atomically hand both unchanged payloads to the named consumer and wait for exact acknowledgement before cleanup
mustNot: share peer report bytes or confidence-score severity
create a subagent, executor, verifier or project registration

cases.scenario: The user makes a generic review request outside the Meta-O lifecycle and supplies no opaque Review-Execution id.
must: avoid implicit Meta-O activation under §A-ACTIVATION-01 and report that the portable header cannot be fabricated
mustNot: change model configuration or invent an execution id

cases.scenario: A follow_up request lacks the reviewer's own prior report and computable prior-SHA delta; the reachable diff also exposes a trust-boundary change requiring deep coverage.
must: under §A-DELIVERY-01 return UNKNOWN for missing follow-up context and name each missing input
under §A-REVIEW-04 record requested=follow_up effective=deep when the context is later supplied
retain a non-empty Unknown-Account and exact end marker
mustNot: deliver a shortened follow-up PASS or silently substitute a model
